analysis.summary: Krishana Phoschem Limited reported Q1 FY27 revenue from operations of ₹532 crore, registering a 35% year-on-year growth, alongside PAT of ₹47 crore. Despite initial quarter disruptions in global supply chains and raw material availability due to West Asia geopolitical tensions, management expects turnover growth of 30%-35% over last year. The company expanded its NPK-DAP capacity to 495,000 MT and introduced new complex fertilizer variants, while also executing a 5-for-1 stock split to improve market liquidity. For Q1 FY27, Krishana Phoschem Limited reported a 34.58% YoY revenue growth to ₹532.3 crore and Profit After Tax growth of 53.88% YoY to ₹47.06 crore. Management highlighted progressive contributions from its expanded capacities at Meghnagar, including NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid facilities.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve an additional 30% to 35% turnover over the previous year during FY27.
guidance.quote: We are hoping that over the remaining quarters, we will be able to smoothen our production, and we will be able to achieve an additional 30%–35% turnover over last year.

guidance.claim: The company expects to generate a quarterly turnover of over ₹500 crore across the remaining three quarters of FY27.
guidance.quote: We expect to achieve a quarterly turnover of more than ₹500 crore over the remaining three quarters of FY27, supported by improved capacity utilization and production.

guidance.claim: The company expects to deliver over 40% growth across key parameters during the current year.
guidance.quote: Accordingly, we expect to deliver growth of over 40% across key parameters during the current year.

guidance.claim: Management expects expanded capacity to contribute an additional revenue increase of around Rs. 500 crore.
guidance.quote: So, you expect an increase of around Rs. 500 crore more, Rs. 2,900 to Rs. 3,000.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall revenue growth in the range of 35% to 40% in FY27.
guidance.quote: So overall, we hope 35%-40% revenue growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The company expects to import approximately 150,000 metric tons of material translating to around Rs. 1,000 crore revenue in FY27.
guidance.quote: For FY27, based on market demand, we expect to import around 150,000 metric tons of material, which would translate into approximately Rs.1,000 crore of revenue.

demand_outlook.claim: Monsoon activity revived in early July, reducing the all-India rainfall deficit to approximately 24%.
demand_outlook.quote: Most importantly, monsoon activity revived strongly in early July, rapidly cutting the all-India rainfall deficit from nearly 40% at June and to approximately 24% by the first week of July.

demand_outlook.claim: The quarter ended March 2026 experienced stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.
demand_outlook.quote: On the Rabi season, the quarter ended March ‘26, witnessed stable demand dynamics during the Rabi season.

demand_outlook.claim: Industry P&K production reached 15.76 lakh metric tonnes during the peak period.
demand_outlook.quote: This was reflected in strong industry performance with P&K production reaching 15.76 lakh metric tonne during the peak period, marking one of the highest monthly output levels.

demand_outlook.claim: A favorable monsoon outlook supports a constructive demand outlook for the sector.
demand_outlook.quote: On one hand, a stable agricultural environment supported by a favorable monsoon outlook provides a constructive demand outlook.

demand_outlook.claim: Fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable as water levels in reservoirs, rivers, and borewells are higher.
demand_outlook.quote: Therefore, we do not expect any stress on the agriculture sector, and consequently, fertilizer demand is expected to remain stable.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities that are yet to be finalized and approved by the board.
capex_expansion.quote: We are currently evaluating certain capacity expansion opportunities.

capex_expansion.claim: A third-party green ammonia capacity under agreement will start supplying in FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: And this capacity will start in FY29 after 2 years.

capex_expansion.claim: Expanded capacities at Meghnagar for NPK/DAP and Sulphuric Acid are contributing progressively to performance.
capex_expansion.quote: Our expanded capacities at Meghnagar — NPK/DAP at 165,000 MTPA and Sulphuric Acid at 99,000 MTPA — are now contributing progressively to our performance.

capex_expansion.claim: The company enhanced NPK/DAP capacity by 50% to 495,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • NPK/DAP capacity enhanced by 50% to 495,000 MTPA and existing SSP capacity at 120,000 MTPA, taking total phosphatic fertilizer capacity to 615,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Backward integration was strengthened by adding sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA.
capex_expansion.quote: • Backward integration strengthened with sulphuric acid capacity of 99,000 MTPA

capex_expansion.claim: Krishana Phoschem signed a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement for 70,000 MTPA under National Green Hydrogen Mission.
capex_expansion.quote: As part of our long-term sustainability strategy, Krishana Phoschem has entered into a 10-year Green Ammonia Sale Agreement (GASA) under India’s National Green Hydrogen Mission for 70,000 MTPA.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has a rock phosphate beneficiation capacity of around 200,000 tons.
capex_expansion.quote: The beneficiation capacity is around 200,000 tons, and current utilization is in the range of 50% to 75%.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins stand at approximately 7% to 8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.
margins_costs.quote: The EBITDA margin is approximately 7%–8% for trading and around 16% for manufacturing.

margins_costs.claim: The company managed to pass on approximately 25% to 30% of raw material cost increases through subsidy support and price revisions.
margins_costs.quote: Overall, we have been able to pass on ~ 25%–30% of the increase in input costs.

margins_costs.claim: Sulphur prices increased sharply from ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to nearly ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.
margins_costs.quote: Sulphur prices have risen from around ₹65,000–₹70,000 per tonne in April to almost ₹1 lakh per tonne in June and July.

margins_costs.claim: Q4 FY26 EBITDA stood at Rs. 90 crore, up 59% year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA came in at Rs.90 crore, registering a 59% YoY growth, supported by operating leverage from higher volumes and stable cost management despite input price volatility.

margins_costs.claim: Full year FY26 EBITDA reached Rs. 298 crore, representing a 62% year-on-year growth.
margins_costs.quote: • EBITDA increased to Rs.298 crore, up 62% YoY, supported by improved operating performance, and a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA per ton for manufactured fertilizer was in the range of Rs. 5,500 per ton in FY26.
margins_costs.quote: It was in the range of Rs.5,500 per ton.

margins_costs.claim: The trading business yields an EBITDA margin between 5% and 6%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin is 5% to 6% in in trading business.

margins_costs.claim: Management expects company profitability to come down slightly during FY27 due to higher input costs.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, of course, we will absorb to some extent and as a result, our profitability is expected to come down slightly during the current year FY27.

orders_capacity.quote: 43% capacity utilization of NPK-DAP unit and 121% capacity utilization of SSP unit, which was beyond the core.

orders_capacity.quote: Our existing NPK-DAP capacity is 330,000 MT, and we have added another 165,000 MT, taking the total capacity to 495,000 MT.

orders_capacity.claim: In Q1 FY27, NPK-DAP sales volume was 53,500 MT and SSP sales volume was 36,300 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: For NPK-DAP, it was 53,500 MT, for SSP 36,300 MT

orders_capacity.claim: Trading volume stood at 21,000 MT for the quarter.
Fertilizer production in Q4 FY26 reached 94,103 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved fertilizer production of 94,103 MT, driven by peak Rabi season demand and improved operational throughput

orders_capacity.claim: Total fertilizer production for FY26 reached 397,263 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: • Achieved total production of 397,263 MT, supported by High demand across markets

orders_capacity.claim: NPK/DAP and SSP plants operated above rated capacity during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: • Record high utilization levels in NPK/DAP and SSP plants operating above rated capacity, highlighting strong market acceptance and efficient asset utilization

orders_capacity.claim: In FY26, manufacturing volumes were approximately 383,000 metric tons and trading volumes were around 93,000 metric tons.
orders_capacity.quote: Trading volumes were approximately 93,000 metric tons, while manufacturing volumes were around 383,000 metric tons.

capital_allocation.claim: The company executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing share face value from ₹10 to ₹2.
capital_allocation.quote: Recently, the company successfully executed a 5-for-1 stock split, subdividing the face value of our equity shares from ₹ 10 per share to ₹ 2 per share.

capital_allocation.claim: Debtors collection in Q1 FY27 exceeded ₹700 crore.
capital_allocation.quote: Collection is more than Rs. 700 crore.

capital_allocation.claim: Disciplined capital allocation is one of the five core pillars of the company's strategic blueprint.
capital_allocation.quote: Our strategic blueprint rests on five core pillars: backward integration, capacity expansion, product diversification, disciplined capital allocation and deep farmer connect.

capital_allocation.claim: Capacity expansion was financed through internal accruals and term loans.
capital_allocation.quote: This expansion has been funded through a prudent mix of internal accruals and term loans, reflecting disciplined capital allocation.

capital_allocation.claim: Non-subsidy trade receivable levels normally range between 50 and 55 days.
capital_allocation.quote: But for subsidy, our receivable levels are normally in the range of 50-55 days.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's effective interest cost ranges from 6% to 7.5%.
capital_allocation.quote: Overall, the effective interest cost is in the range of 6% to 7.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia and Strait of Hormuz shipping lane disruptions created supply chain uncertainty and increased freight costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geopolitical tensions in West Asia, particularly surrounding critical shipping lanes through the Strait of Hormuz, introduced considerable uncertainty across global industry, global fertilizer supply chains during the quarter.

risks_headwinds.claim: Raw material availability was the primary challenge faced by the company in Q1 FY27.
risks_headwinds.quote: The primary challenge during the first quarter was the availability of raw materials.

risks_headwinds.claim: Depreciation and finance costs rose due to the commissioning of new plant capacity.
risks_headwinds.quote: Depreciation increased from around ₹8.7 crore to ₹13 crore, while finance costs increased from around ₹13 crore to ₹20 crore.

risks_headwinds.claim: Global input prices for ammonia and sulphur firmed up from mid-February due to supply-side constraints and logistics costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: However, from mid-February onwards, global market witnessed firming trends driven by supply-side constraints, tightness in gas-linked production, higher logistic and freight costs.

risks_headwinds.claim: Initial teething issues are expected in Q1 or Q2 for the newly commenced expansion.
risks_headwinds.quote: The new expansion has commenced this month, and there may be some initial teething issues in the first or second quarter.
